us: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Hopefully the village will see more travelers{line}again. Travelers bring talk, news from the world{line}beyond the sands.{page}Does it put food on our plates? No. But it's{line}pleasant all the same.
de: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Fernab der Zivilisation bekommen wir von der{line}Welt außerhalb der Wüste kaum etwas mit.{page}Deshalb heißen wir jeden Reisenden willkommen,{line}der hier Halt macht und uns etwas über die Ge-{line}schehnisse jenseits der Wüste erzählen kann.
es: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Espero que pronto volvamos a recibir más{line}viajeros. Me encanta oír las historias que{line}cuentan sobre el mundo más allá del desierto.{page}No ganamos mucho dinero con ellos, pero es{line}agradable recibir visitas de vez en cuando.
fr: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}J'espère que des voyageurs feront de nouveau{line}escale au village. Ce sont eux qui nous amènent{line}les rumeurs et les nouvelles du monde.{page}Bien sûr, ce ne sont pas leurs histoires qui nous{line}nourrissent, mais elles nous divertissent.
it: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Qui al villaggio la vita scorre tranquilla.{line}Sappiamo a malapena cosa succede nel resto{line}del mondo grazie a qualche viaggiatore.
in: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}この集落にも、また旅人が訪れるようになるといいな。{line}ここには砂漠の外の話が全然伝わってこないからね。{line}まあ、暮らしには関係ないけどさ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}이 마을에도 다시 여행자들이 찾아오게 되면 좋겠어.{line}이곳에선 사막 바깥의 얘기를 전혀 들을 수가 없거든.{line}뭐, 생활하는 덴 지장이 없지만 말이지.
cn: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}要是这个聚落又会有旅人来访就好了呢。{line}毕竟沙漠外围的消息完全不会传到这里。{line}虽然不影响生活就是了。
ch: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}要是這個聚落又會有旅人來訪就好了呢。{line}畢竟沙漠外圍的消息完全不會傳到這裡。{line}雖然不影響生活就是了。

us: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}A traveling merchant made the crossing not long{line}ago. Told of a great war brewing... The world's{line}stirring out there, beyond the sands.
de: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Ein reisender Händler sprach neulich von einem{line}Krieg, der über Ivalice hereinbrechen soll.{line}Das wäre schrecklich, nicht wahr ...?
es: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Hace poco, un viajero que cruzó el río me dijo{line}que va a empezar una gran guerra. Se ve que{line}las cosas andan muy revueltas fuera de aquí.
fr: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Un marchand itinérant a traversé le fleuve,{line}récemment. Il nous a dit qu'une grande guerre{line}se préparait. Le monde s'agite, hors du désert !
it: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Qualche giorno fa un mercante mi ha detto che{line}sta per scoppiare la guerra. Il mondo fuori{line}dal deserto si fa sempre più pericoloso.
in: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}この前、河を渡った商人に聞いたんだけどさ、{line}大きな戦争が始まるんだって？{line}砂漠の外ではえらいことになってるんだなあ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}일전에 강을 건넌 상인에게 들었는데{line}큰 전쟁이 시작될 거라며?{line}사막 밖은 지금 아주 어지러운 모양이군.
cn: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}之前我听渡河而来的商人说到，{line}是不是有大型战争要开始了呀？{line}沙漠外围的状况变得惊人呢。
ch: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}之前我聽渡河而來的商人說到，{line}是不是有大型戰爭要開始了呀？{line}沙漠外圍的狀況變得驚人呢。

us: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}I like to think of our experience with the{line}cactoids as a positive one. After all, I may never{line}have set foot outside the desert if not for them.
de: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Vor etliche Gefahren stellten uns die bösen{line}Kaktoren. Andererseits hätte ich die Wüste nie{line}verlassen, wären sie nicht gewesen ...
es: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}En el fondo no estuvo mal que los cactus me{line}arrastraran de aquí para allá. Si no, seguramente{line}nunca habría salido del desierto.
fr: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Finalement, je me dis que notre mésaventure avec{line}les pampas a été une chance. Après tout, sans eux,{line}je ne serais sûrement jamais sorti du désert.
it: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}L'esperienza con i Cactus è stata molto{line}istruttiva. Senza di loro non avrei mai{line}messo piede fuori dal deserto.
in: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}サボテンたちに世界中連れ回されたのは、{line}貴重な体験だったかもな。あんな事件がなければ、{line}一生この砂漠から出なかったと思うんだ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}사보텐들에게 전 세계로 끌려다녔던 건{line}귀중한 체험이었을지도 몰라. 그 사건이 없었더라면{line}평생 이 사막에서 나갈 일이 없었을 테니까.
cn: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}被那些仙人掌带着世界各地到处跑，{line}或许是种宝贵的体验呢。要不是因为有那种事件发生，{line}我这辈子大概都不会离开沙漠吧。
ch: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}被那些仙人掌帶著世界各地到處跑，{line}或許是種寶貴的體驗呢。要不是因為有那種事件發生，{line}我這輩子大概都不會離開沙漠吧。

us: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}I like to think of our experience with the{line}cactoids as a positive one. After all, I may never{line}have set foot outside the desert if not for them.
de: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Vor etliche Gefahren stellten uns die bösen{line}Kaktoren. Andererseits hätte ich die Wüste nie{line}verlassen, wären sie nicht gewesen ...
es: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}En el fondo no estuvo mal que los cactus me{line}arrastraran de aquí para allá. Si no, seguramente{line}nunca habría salido del desierto.
fr: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}Finalement, je me dis que notre mésaventure avec{line}les pampas a été une chance. Après tout, sans eux,{line}je ne serais sûrement jamais sorti du désert.
it: {instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}L'esperienza con i Cactus è stata molto{line}istruttiva. Senza di loro non avrei mai{line}messo piede fuori dal deserto.
in: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}サボテンたちに世界中連れ回されたのは、{line}貴重な体験だったかもな。あんな事件がなければ、{line}一生この砂漠から出なかったと思うんだ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}사보텐들에게 전 세계로 끌려다녔던 건{line}귀중한 체험이었을지도 몰라. 그 사건이 없었더라면{line}평생 이 사막에서 나갈 일이 없었을 테니까.
cn: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8281A4}{line}被那些仙人掌带着世界各地到处跑，{line}或许是种宝贵的体验呢。要不是因为有那种事件发生，{line}我这辈子大概都不会离开沙漠吧。

es: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Por fin vuelve a funcionar el servicio para cruzar{line}el río. ¿Quieres ir a la {color:8093}orilla sur{color:8080}?{line}{choice:2}[Sí.|No, gracias.]

us: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Well, we got Sassan to the north bank, but{line}look. The poor thing's terrified of Nathyl.{line}He's too scared to even get off the boat.{page}You want I should take him back across?{line}{choice:2}[Yeah, let's try this again.|Not just yet.]
de: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Hm, Sasana ist jetzt zwar hier, aber Nasir{line}macht ihm einfach zu viel Angst. Guck mal, ihm{line}zittern ja alle Federn! Der geht nie an Land.{page}Willst du 's nochmal versuchen?{line}{choice:2}[Aller guten Dinge sind, äh, na gut|Nee, keine Lust im Moment]
es: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Ya estamos en la orilla norte, pero Sazán{line}tiene tanto miedo de Nathyl que no se{line}atreve ni a bajar del muelle...{page}¿Volvemos a la orilla sur y empezamos otra vez?{line}{choice:2}[Sí, sí.|Aún no.]
fr: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Bon, on a réussi à faire venir Sassan sur la rive{line}nord, mais maintenant, il est terrorisé par Nathyl.{line}Il a si peur qu'il refuse de descendre du bateau.{page}Vous voulez que je le ramène sur l'autre rive ?{line}{choice:2}[Oui, il vaut mieux.|Non, pas encore.]
it: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Siamo riusciti a portare qui Sasana,{line}ma è terrorizzato dalla presenza di Nacil.{line}Non riesce neanche a scendere dalla barca.{page}Torniamo indietro e ricominciamo da capo?{line}{choice:2}[Okay.|No, lasciamo stare.]
in: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}せっかく北岸までササナを連れてきたけど、{line}やっぱりナシルのことが怖いみたいだね。{line}すっかりおびえて舟から降りないんだ。{page}もう一度、始めからやり直す？{line}{choice:2}[やり直す|そのままにする]
kr: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}모처럼 북쪽 기슭까지 사사나를 데려왔지만,{line}역시 나실이 무서운 것 같군.{line}완전히 겁을 먹어서 배에서 내리지 않아.{page}다시 한번, 처음부터 할래?{line}{choice:2}[다시 한다|그냥 둔다]

us: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Okay, but Sassan's pretty scared. Don't you{line}think I oughta take him back across?

it: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Ma il povero Sasana è terrorizzato.{line}Secondo me è meglio ricominciare da capo.
in: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}でも、ササナがすっかりおびえちゃってるから、{line}やり直した方がいいと思うよ？

us: {instant:8181}{name:A283E5}{line}An errand saw me in Giza when Sassan and his{line}friends hatched.{page}Ever since, he's come to visit me from time to{line}time. I think he must think I'm his mother or{line}something. Isn't he adorable?
de: {instant:8181}{name:A283E5}{line}Ich lebte damals in Giza, als Sasana und{line}die anderen Küken zur Welt kamen.{page}Seither kommt er mich ab und zu besuchen ...{line}Vielleicht hält er mich für seine Mutter?
es: {instant:8181}{name:A283E5}{line}Vi nacer a Sazán y a sus compañeros una vez{line}que estaba de viaje por Giza.{page}Desde entonces viene a visitarme de vez en{line}cuando. ¿Tal vez crea que soy su madre?{line}Es tan cariñoso...
fr: {instant:8181}{name:A283E5}{line}J'étais de passage à Giza quand Sassan{line}et ses amis sont éclos.{page}Depuis, il vient me rendre visite de temps{line}en temps. Il doit me prendre pour sa mère.{line}Il est adorable, non ?
it: {instant:8181}{name:A283E5}{line}Tempo fa ho vissuto a Giza per un po'{line}e lì ho conosciuto Sasana e gli altri.{line}Vedessi com'erano carini appena nati!{page}Da allora, ogni tanto Sasana mi viene a trovare.{line}Forse mi considera come la sua mamma.
in: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:A283E5}{line}以前、用事があってギーザに滞在していた時に、{line}生まれたばかりのササナたちに会ったの。{page}それ以来、あの子ちょくちょく私に会いに来るのよ。{line}母親だと思ってるのかしらね。うふふ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:A283E5}{line}전에 볼일이 있어서 기자에 체류할 때,{line}막 태어난 사사나들을 만났어.{page}그 이후로, 쟤는 가끔씩 나를 만나러 와.{line}엄마라고 생각하는 걸까. 우후후.
cn: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:A283E5}{line}之前我因为有事留在居札时，{line}见到了刚出生没多久的沙沙纳它们。{page}从此以后，那孩子就不时会来见我。{line}是把我当成母亲了吗？唔呵呵。

us: {instant:8181}{name:8284DE}{line}My friends had just been married when this{line}cactoid business separated them. I'm so happy{line}to see them back together!
de: {instant:8181}{name:8284DE}{line}Jetzt schau dir die zwei Turteltäubchen an. Frisch{line}verheiratet wurden sie wegen der Kaktoren ge-{line}trennt, aber das ist schon nicht mehr jugendfrei.
es: {instant:8181}{name:8284DE}{line}¿Has visto a esos dos? Acababan de casarse cuando{line}se vieron separados por el incidente de los cactus.{page}Entiendo que tuvieran ganas de verse,{line}pero podrían ser más discretos en público,{line}¿no te parece?
fr: {instant:8181}{name:8284DE}{line}Vous avez vu les deux amoureux ?{line}Ils venaient de se marier quand{line}l'affaire des pampas les a séparés.{page}Je comprends qu'ils soient heureux de se{line}retrouver, mais là, franchement, c'est trop !{line}Ils n'ont donc aucune pudeur ?
it: {instant:8181}{name:8284DE}{line}Quei due là, guardali, che spudorati.{line}Capisco che sono sposini e il problema dei{line}Cactus li ha tenuti lontani, ma insomma!
in: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8284DE}{line}あのふたり、新婚早々サボテン事件で離れ離れだったの。{line}会いたかったのはわかるけど、あれはやりすぎよ！{line}目のやり場に困っちゃうわ。
kr: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:8284DE}{line}저 둘, 결혼하자마자 사보텐 사건 때문에 생이별했었어.{line}만나고 싶었던 건 이해하지만, 저건 너무 심하잖아!{line}눈을 어디에 둬야 할지 모르겠다고.

us: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}I don't like the look of this one bit. Seems like{line}they're holding 'em hostage. But what would{line}cactoids want with hostages?
de: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Wir müssen sie retten. Schau doch, die Kaktoren{line}halten sie als Geiseln gefangen! Wieso machen{line}die so was!?
es: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}¿Qué hacemos?...{line}Parece que los cactus los han tomado{line}como rehenes. Pero ¿por qué?...
fr: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Je n'aime pas du tout ça ! On dirait qu'ils les{line}ont pris en otage. Mais pour quelle raison{line}des pampas pourraient-ils vouloir des otages ?
it: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}Sono stati rapiti!{line}Ma perché?{line}Cosa facciamo?

kr: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}어쩌지……{line}아빠랑 사람들이 인질로 잡혔나 봐!{line}왜 사보텐이 마을 사람들을?
cn: {spacing:8181}{instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}该怎么办……{line}爸爸他们被挟持了！{line}为什么仙人掌会挟持聚落的人？

us: {instant:8181}{name:828192}{line}I don't believe it!

us: {instant:8181}{name:A280EA}{line}I bloomin' missed ya, Torrie! Wot's it gonna{line}take to get ya to settle down wiv me, eh?

us: {instant:8181}{name:A280EA}{line}Wot's Terra got to do wiv it? This is between you{line}an' me, Torrie. Yer always tryin' to avoid it, but{line}enough's enough! It's time to listen to yer 'eart!
de: {instant:8181}{name:A280EA}{line}Was hat Terr dennig damit zu tun! Hier{line}geht es ja wohl einzig um mir und dir!{line}Immer hältst dich mir hin.

it: {instant:8181}{name:A280EA}{line}Cosa c'entra Tera!{line}Questa è una faccenda tra te e me!{line}Eviti, diciamo, sempre l'argomento!

us: {instant:8181}{name:A280EA}{line}I'm yer fav'rite? 'Onest? Sure yer ain't pullin'{line}me leg? Ya don't fancy Renn or Moomer?

us: {instant:8181}{name:A280EA}{line}Yer 'ear that!? I'm only 'er blinkin' fav'rite!{line}Me! Hoo hoo hoo! I betta 'urry back to Giza an'{line}announce our plans fer the weddin'!
